title: 'Call of Duty' slammed for using real Seoul crowd crush footage
summary: Families of victims of South Korea's deadly Halloween crowd crush have demanded that footage of the disaster used in the latest installment of "Call of Duty" be removed, a representative told AFP…

blocks.text: Families of victims of South Korea's deadly Halloween crowd crush have demanded that footage of the disaster used in the latest installment of "Call of Duty" be removed, a representative told AFP Thursday, condemning its "complete lack of sensitivity.”
